label: Wat Lao Noi

scripts.label: Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา

samples: Tamnan munlalok, Tamnan pan pai ha hoi pi
Putthatamnan sasana ha pan watsa, lokahani
Tamnan pha tao song pha ong

lede: Wat Lao Noi accounts for 17 catalogued manuscripts, 1 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Lampang (94% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Thoen District. Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1818–1960 CE (13 of 17 carry a date).
